title: Arrest Of A German National In Cathay Theatre

page_data.en:
F.M. 2
G. 90M-1-39

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch Division.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY File No. 20(c) No. N. 20(c) Date 15/5/40 H.O.）
Date May 14 , 40

Subject Arrest of a German national in Cathay Theatre.

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

FC. 274*.

Commr of Police
Sir:
Information.
R.D. York
D.C. (Sp. Br.)
14/
/5.

（印：SHANGHAI COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE FILE 15 MAY 1940）

The present picture at the Cathay Theatre,
Rue Cardinal Mercier and Avenue Joffre, is the
// "Lion Has Wings," a British production. On
Saturday evening, May 11th, at the 9.15 p.m. show,
a German national named R. WILLERS, employed in
Carlowitz & Co., Szechuen Road, who was one of
the audience, jumped to his feet and gave the
Nazi salute, at the same time shouting "Heil
Hitler", when a picture of the Reich Chancellor
appeared in the film. He was asked to desist
by the people near him but became obstreperous
and was removed by members of the French Police
who had been called in by the management.
According to information from a reliable source
he was detained over night by the French Police
but this is denied in official quarters, who
maintain he was released shortly after arrest.
The matter is being treated very confidential.

C. Crawford
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科 档案室 档案号 20(c) 编号 N. 20(c) 日期 40年5月15日 总部）
日期 1940年5月14日

事由：在国泰大戏院逮捕一名德国国民。

由警探长克劳福德（Crawford）撰写并呈报

FC. 274*.

致警察总监
阁下：
情报。
R.D. York
副总监（特务科）
14/
/5.

（印：上海警察总监办公室 档案 1940年5月15日）

目前位于梅爱赫路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）与霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的国泰大戏院，
正在放映英国影片《雄狮展翅》（"Lion Has Wings"）。
5月11日星期六晚，在晚上9点15分的场次中，
一名名为 R. WILLERS 的德国国民，受雇于四川路的卡洛维茨洋行（Carlowitz & Co.），作为观众之一，
当电影中出现德国总理的画面时，他跳起身来，行纳粹礼，
同时高呼“希特勒万岁”（Heil Hitler）。
周围人士要求其停止，但他态度嚣张，
随后被管理方召来的法国巡捕带走。
据可靠消息来源称，
他被法国巡捕拘留过夜，
但官方方面予以否认，坚称其在被捕后不久即获释。
此事正以高度机密方式处理。

C. Crawford
警探长

副总监（特务科）

归档索引
（S. 3）档案室
日期 40年5月15日
